section.title: Models
section.description: Connect AI providers with an API key, or add your team's own gateway.

connected.heading: Connected
connected.emptyDescription: Connect one below, or add a custom gateway, to start chatting.

gateways.heading: Custom gateways
gateways.hint: A gateway is an OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible address your team runs or buys.

providerRow.disconnectDescription: Its saved key is removed from this computer. Chats that use its models will switch to another model.

displayName.label: Display name of {{id}}
displayName.hint: Display name. Blank: the name the gateway or Pi knows, else a tidied id.

contextWindow.label: Context window of {{id}}, in tokens
contextWindow.hint: Context window in tokens. Blank: the model's known size, else 128000.

gatewayForm.noModelsListed: The gateway didn't list any models. Add them by name.

apiType.label: API type
apiType.description: Most gateways are OpenAI-compatible. Ask your tech team.

url.label: Gateway URL
url.invalid: Enter a web address starting with https:// or http://
url.description: The address your team uses for AI requests.

requiresKey.label: This gateway needs an API key
requiresKey.description: Turn off for local endpoints such as Ollama, LM Studio or vLLM that take no key.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.descriptionOptional: Only needed if the endpoint checks one. Stored encrypted in your system keychain.
apiKey.placeholderSaved: Saved. Leave blank to keep it.
apiKey.description: Stored encrypted in your system keychain.

models.description: Load the gateway's list, or add models by name.
models.manualPlaceholder: Or type a model name, like gpt-4o
models.duplicateNames: Several models share the name {{names}}. The model list adds the model id to tell them apart; give them different names to avoid that.

gatewayRow.deleteDescription: The gateway and its saved key are removed from this computer. Chats that use its models will switch to another model.
